about_short_description.short_description: Fine Diner is a food delivery and restaurant brand specializing in British comfort food.

product.name: Yorkshire Burritos
product.description: A food product combining traditional British roast dinner ingredients wrapped in a Yorkshire pudding for portable consumption.

product.name: Classic Roast Dinners
product.description: Pre-cooked British roast dinners available in various meat options, served with traditional sides and delivered ready to eat.

product.name: Family Feast Roasts
product.description: Large pre-cooked roast meals designed to serve families, including meat, sides, and trimmings, available by pre-order.

product.name: British Pies & Pasties
product.description: Traditional British savory pies and pasties served with chips or mashed potatoes, available for delivery.

product.name: Afternoon Tea
product.description: A set of sandwiches, sweets, and scones with clotted cream and jam, delivered on a three-tier platter.

product.name: Mezeh Platters
product.description: Assorted platters featuring a variety of Levantine appetizers served with freshly baked bread, available in classic and vegetarian options.
